cards.card_text: Then he asks, "If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for human motives, what did I gain?"
cards.verse_text: I face death every day, brothers, as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord. If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for human motives, what did I gain? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
